hardware.tested_state: get_signing_status omits implemented parser_limits and approval_digest_binding gates

procedure: Updated the shared ESP32-S3 signing-status vector so parser_limits and approval_digest_binding are no longer reported as missing for the scaffold profile.
Updated ESP32 host-core signing-status diagnostics to mark parser limits and approval-digest binding as implemented while keeping signing disabled.
Ran nSealr/specs make ci, nSealr/companion make ci, and nSealr/esp32 make ci before flashing.
Exported ESP-IDF v5.5.4 from /Users/vincenzo/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh in the same shell invocation used for build, flash, and smoke.
Verified idf.py and esptool.py paths and confirmed idf.py --version reported ESP-IDF v5.5.4.
Built clean app version d67f587 with make IDF_PORT=/dev/cu.usbmodem1101 idf-flash.
Flashed bootloader, app, and partition table to /dev/cu.usbmodem1101 and verified image hashes.
expected_result: The firmware exposes refined signing-readiness diagnostics while preserving the disabled signing protocol contract.
observed_result: ESP-IDF v5.5.4 built app version d67f587 with binary size 0x8a890 and 0x75770 bytes free in the app partition. esptool detected ESP32-S3 QFN56 revision v0.2 with native USB-Serial/JTAG and MAC ec:da:3b:95:32:98, wrote bootloader, app, and partition-table images, and verified hashes. The smoke passed with 35 verified exchanges: 8 valid response frames and 27 expected rejection frames. get_signing_status returned signing_enabled false and no longer listed parser_limits or approval_digest_binding as missing gates. Remaining blockers were runtime_signing_feature, trusted_review_display, physical_approval_controls, key_provisioning, secure_boot, flash_encryption, debug_lock, and companion_signed_output_verification. sign_event remained signing_disabled.
limitations: Protocol smoke only; no production key custody, trusted display acceptance, physical approval acceptance, secure boot, flash encryption, debug-lock, or real signing acceptance was tested.
get_signing_status is diagnostic only and does not authorize signing.
get_public_key still uses the deterministic development fixture key.
sign_event is expected to remain signing_disabled until trusted display review, physical approval, provisioning, storage, signed-output verification, and firmware hardening gates are complete.
